_comment: Vibe-Trading run-dir config for the Forex Swing-ORB SignalEngine. The forex engine (ForexEngine) is auto-selected from the EURUSD.FX symbol. execution_tf is 15m per the frozen spec; H4/D1 trend is derived by resampling inside the SignalEngine. Phase 1 is signal generation + validation only: no filesystem bridge, no MT5, no broker.
